modules.name: Magisk OverlayFS
modules.description: Makes /system read-write via OverlayFS. This fork fixes compatibility with newer Magisk releases.
modules.author: agreenbhm

modules.name: VD Telemetry Guard
modules.description: Zygisk module that stops Virtual Desktop's native telemetry client from being created and blocks its event-creation wrapper, fixing a memory leak when VD telemetry is disabled in Singularity. Requires Magisk 27+ with Zygisk enabled.
modules.author: Walaryne

modules.name: Vector
modules.description: Modern Xposed-compatible hooking framework (Zygisk module). Required before installing modules from the Vector tab.
modules.author: JingMatrix

modules.name: Quest Pro Display Overclock
modules.description: Unlocks 100/110/120Hz refresh rates on Meta Quest Pro (stock is 90Hz). Reversible by disabling or removing the module.
modules.author: CreoleVR

modules.name: Quest Pro Independent Eye Gaze
modules.description: Patches the eye-tracking model on-device to emit independent per-eye gaze instead of a fixed-depth binocular convergence, and disables social gaze filtering. Requires Magisk OverlayFS.
modules.author: Walaryne

modules.name: Quest 1 90Hz Override
modules.description: True 90Hz on the Quest 1. Requires a 90Hz-patched boot.img to be flashed first. Sleep/wake once after each boot for it to apply.
modules.author: Juspertinry

modules.name: Quest 1 System Audio Effects
modules.description: Patches the audio effects config so system-wide EQ apps work again. Adds roughly 250ms of audio latency.
modules.author: Juspertinry

modules.name: Quest 1 Passthrough Colorizer
modules.description: Applies a custom tint and strength to system-wide passthrough.
modules.author: Juspertinry

modules.name: Quest 1 Headless Tracking Patch
modules.description: Fixes the tracking loss caused by removing the screen (headless mod).
modules.author: Juspertinry

modules.name: Quest 2 Touch on Quest 3
modules.description: Lets Quest 2 Touch controllers connect and track motion on a Quest 3, without changing the headset's stock system files.
modules.author: LiterallyAxo

modules.name: Quest 3 Touch+ on Quest 2
modules.description: Lets Quest 3 Touch+ controllers be paired and motion-tracked on a Quest 2, though tracking can be unreliable.
modules.author: Noculus-VR

modules.name: Inside-Out Body Tracking Fix
modules.description: Adjusts system properties to fix inside-out body tracking on Quest 3 and Quest 3S.
modules.author: Lumince
